genres: Coming of Age Fiction for Young Adults
results.description:
She never felt like she belonged…until magic pulled her into a world where she finally might.

Sixteen-year-old Aurora wishes she were anyone else. Mistreated by her adopted family and bullied at school, she dreams of a life where she truly matters. But when she's pulled through an ancient tapestry into the magical world of Avalonia, she discovers a world of magic and destiny beyond anything she imagined.

Avalonia is a land of powerful mages, immortal fae, and seven fragile kingdoms threatened by the rise of the tyrant Queen Morgana. As the last surviving heir of the legendary Firedrake dynasty, Aurora finds herself hunted, and suddenly important in ways she never expected. Enrolled at the prestigious Academy of Evolon, she must learn to control her rare abilities, navigate a world filled with ancient magic, and discover who she truly is.

Aided by the powerful Duke of Silverthorne, a fae friend, and a handsome but mysterious outlaw called the Black Wolf, Aurora's journey is one of courage and self-discovery, where the fate of her new home and family hang in the balance…

Perfect for readers who love classic young adult fantasy featuring:

•portal fantasy and magic academies
•dragons and ancient magic
•resilient, kind heroines
•found family and coming-of-age journeys
•a gentle, slow-burn romantic thread

The Last of the Firedrakes is the first book in The Avalonia Chronicles, a classic, hopeful YA fantasy series with a modern heroine who discovers her power, her place, and her worth. Ideal for readers who miss the wonder of Harry Potter or Narnia and want a richly imagined world they can truly escape into.

Enter Avalonia and discover a fantasy with real magic and heart.

AWARDS

Silver award winner in IBPA's Benjamin Franklin Awards 2016

Silver Medal winner in the 2016 Readers' Favorite Book Award

Semifinalist winner in the 2016 Kindle Book Award

Finalist in the 2015 USA Best Book Awards

Winner in Wattpad's 2015 Watty Awards

PRAISE FOR The Last of the Firedrakes

"The Last of the Firedrakes is a magic-filled romp that carries you back to the fantasy stories of childhood...Lovers of classic fantasy will likewise gobble down Oomerbhoy's scrumptious story." - Vic James, author of Gilded Cage

"...the narrative components echo the classics; the Academy of Magic at Evolon could be Hogwarts, while the Shadow Guards are reminiscent of Tolkien's Ring Wraiths or Rowling's Dementors...a beautifully drawn fantasy world." - Kirkus Reviews

"The Last of the Firedrakes has all the elements of popular fantasy - an orphaned princess, Magical powers, an alternate sphere with seven kingdoms, a young girl with a destiny to fulfil. They are all elements of the Narnia Chronicles, The Faraway tree, The Harry Potter series, Lord of the Rings and a bit of Enid Blyton fun." - Mid-Day newspaper

"The Last of the Firedrakes is a fantasy novel that will entrance young adult and adult readers alike... Political intrigue, danger, and deep characterization make for an interconnected epic, enthusiastically recommended for high fantasy connoisseurs." - Midwest Book Review
